== Biography ==
William Thomson is represented by the Edinburgh household of Grissell Peirie. His inherited birth about 1638 and Edinburgh birthplace are estimates, not established birth facts.

A printed parish marriage index records Grizel Peirie and William Thomson on 27 November 1663, describing William as servant to Sir William Thomson, town clerk. The groom is not thereby the town clerk himself or his relative.<ref name="Paton541">Henry Paton, ed., ''A Register of Marriages for the Parish of Edinburgh, 1595–1700'' (1905), [https://electricscotland.com/history/records/scottishrecordso16scotuoft.pdf#page=551 p. 541; PDF p. 551]. Printed page visually verified 15 November 2026; original parish register uninspected.</ref>

The imported family names five children with Edinburgh christenings: William, 18 December 1664; Thomas, 23 May 1669; Thomas, 28 August 1670; John, 14 July 1672; and Grissell, 4 January 1674. These dates are inherited tree assertions; the two Thomas profiles remain separate. The public WikiTree family observations preserve Grissell Peirie’s Ancestral File number 1XNQ-PP1 and the Savage.ged import of 21 February 2011.<ref>WikiTree public family observations for [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Thomson-263 Thomson-263] and [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Peirie-1 Peirie-1], retrieved 15 November 2026. Imported family provenance; not independent evidence for the inherited birth estimates or every child’s baptism.</ref>

An inspected FamilySearch christening index names William’s parents as William Thomson and Grissell Peirie, dated 18 December 1664 at Edinburgh.<ref>“Scotland Births and Baptisms,” FamilySearch, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1Y2-R5W William Thomson, christening 18 December 1664, Edinburgh], indexed parents William Thomson and Grissell Peirie; index inspected 15 November 2026. Original parish manuscript uninspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The existing [https://www.familysearch.org/en/tree/person/details/LR4G-4QS FamilySearch account LR4G-4QS] is an intended-household match with medium confidence through the 1664 child and Grissell Peirie (9796-FLG). FamilySearch displays marriage on 27 November 1662; the printed Paton entry gives 27 November 1663. The year discrepancy remains pending original-register inspection. The displayed 1753 death, title “Father”, ancestry and additional children are not endorsed by this match. No parentage confidence is changed.

A possible identification concerns William Thomsone. The banns/marriage index records Agnes Glasgow and William Thomsone on 15 December 1681 at Carstairs.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 633/10 / 66; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
